def longest(take a: list[int], take b: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    """Consume both lists and return the longer one; the first wins a tie."""
    ex longest([1, 2], [3]) == [1, 2]
    ex longest([1], [2, 3]) == [2, 3]
    ex longest([1, 2], [3, 4]) == [1, 2]
    if a.len() >= b.len():
        return a
    return b
